name: Ralph's Apple Ranch
description: Ralph's Apple Ranch is an apple orchard in Camino, CA. Visitors come for Apples, Pears, Peaches, Nectarines, and Plums, best in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
